scope: Independent semantic and grammatical composition review of the separate later Jeju pair. No edits to production resources, frozen 53-pair upload, or earlier evidence.

exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_unavailable: SVG에 적어진 쓸 수 있는 원래 크기가 엇수다. 캔버스 크기를 기준으로 헌 크기를 대신 쓰지 아니허엿수다.
exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_too_large: SVG의 원래 크기가 Android 비트맵 크기 한도를 넘엇수다. 크기 조절은 아니 허엿수다.

clause_review.source_claim: SVG does not state usable original dimensions
clause_review.candidate_segment: SVG에 적어진 쓸 수 있는 원래 크기가 엇수다.
clause_review.assessment: Coherent. Both pre-nominal modifiers attach to 원래 크기: recorded in SVG and usable. Negated existence applies to that restricted class, so it does not claim every possible size is absent. Written/recorded in the named SVG is an ordinary file-information paraphrase of declare; it does not introduce inability to decode or a visible-text-only requirement.
clause_review.remaining_uncertainty: The stacked modifiers are heavy and could be polished by a fluent editor. The recorded passive comes from interviewer speech, which is weaker evidence than independent informant use. Neither point establishes a concrete meaning failure.

clause_review.source_claim: No canvas-derived substitute size was used
clause_review.candidate_segment: 캔버스 크기를 기준으로 헌 크기를 대신 쓰지 아니허엿수다.
clause_review.assessment: Coherent. The object of use is the following 크기, modified by the canvas-size-as-basis relative clause. 대신 gives the substitute role; it does not say the canvas itself was resized. 쓰지 plus the completed negative auxiliary reports non-use in the past, without a cannot, automatic-only, shrink-only or future-only restriction.
clause_review.remaining_uncertainty: 기준으로 헌 and the sentence-final 아니허엿수다 are new combinations of supported constructions and the catalogue register. No source is represented as containing this whole technical sentence.

clause_review.source_claim: Original SVG dimensions exceed Android bitmap dimensional bounds
clause_review.candidate_segment: SVG의 원래 크기가 Android 비트맵 크기 한도를 넘엇수다.
clause_review.assessment: Coherent. The subject is the original size of SVG and the exceeded bound belongs to Android bitmap size. In this image-dimensions context, 크기 한도 retains the dimensional claim; there is no bytes, file-size, free-memory or application-budget substitution. Perfective exceeded is a normal result-report rendering of the failed limit comparison.
clause_review.remaining_uncertainty: The long technical noun chain and inherited 넘엇수다 spelling/register still need fluent Jeju editorial acceptance. Shared technical nouns alone are neither proof of correctness nor a reason to reject the clause.

clause_review.assessment: Coherent. Size adjustment is the topic and ordinary negation directly precedes the past do predicate. It reports that no adjustment was done. The topic marker may foreground that operation, but does not assert other changes occurred or narrow the no-resizing claim. Separate 아니 허엿수다 is consistent with this short-negative structure, distinct from the long-negative auxiliary in the unavailable message.
clause_review.remaining_uncertainty: Complete finite form, spacing and polite UI register are editorial choices still awaiting fluent-speaker review.

genuine_jeju_support.conclusion: This is more than replacing Korean sentence endings. The ability-relative, basis relative, substitute-use expression and completed negative auxiliary have actual Jeju-layer corpus evidence; the absence predicate and negative constructions have linguistic support. Shared items such as 쓸 수 있는 and technical loanwords are not disqualified merely because Korean shares them.
genuine_jeju_support.important_distinction: 적어진 is attested in the interviewer utterance. 적힌 appears in the aligned standard-Korean gloss and is not counted as the Jeju corpus form.
genuine_jeju_support.whole_sentence_attestation: Not established and not claimed. Its absence alone is not a blocker to compositionally coherent source-assisted draft inclusion.
